subject: Glasgow-4070
basis: Original Plattsburgh Sentinel, 6 November 1891, p. 8, visually inspected; compared with Nancy’s original January 1889 will age.
summary: Contemporary notice corroborates 31 October 1891 death at Plattsburgh and reports about 75; birth-age conflict with the will remains unresolved.

birth.label: Conflicting approximate ages
birth.note: Death notice says about 75 in October 1891; will says about 68 in January 1889. These are alternative estimates, not proved endpoints of a birth interval. Maintained census indexes report 30 in 1860, 50 in 1870 and 65 in 1880, implying further estimates; these ages do not define a proved birth interval.

death.note: Original contemporary death notice gives exact date and town; independently agrees with cemetery transcription.
